description: getVpsPackageDetails: Get detailed information about a specific VPS package including all pricing tiers. Requires authentication. For anonymous browsing use listVpsPackages, which already includes per-term pricing.

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.
